title: IterInt: Evaluating iterated integrals via differential equations
summary: We introduce IterInt, a novel package implemented in both Mathematica and C++ for the numerical evaluation of iterated integrals involving arbitrary integration kernels. After the user has defined the integration kernels, IterInt transforms the iterated integrals into a system of first-order linear differential equations which can be solved efficiently and with high precision using well established libraries.
